facts.text: Franklin's Tuition Guarantee allows bachelor's and associate degree-seeking students to lock in their first-term tuition rate for up to four years (12 trimesters).

sources.title: Tuition Guarantee | Franklin University
sources.quote: Bachelor's and associate degree-seeking students can lock in their first-term tuition rate for up to four years (12 trimesters), while master's students can lock in their first-term rate for up to three years (9 trimesters).

facts.text: Students can transfer up to 94 community or technical college credit hours toward a bachelor's degree at Franklin.

sources.title: Online College That Accepts Max Transfer Credits | Franklin.edu
sources.quote: Franklin makes it easy to transfer up to 94 of your community or technical college credit hours toward a bachelor's degree.
